description: This file defines the IMediaKeysClient interface, which is an abstract base class for handling media key events such as license requests, license renewals, and key status changes within the Rialto media framework. It is part of the Rialto project and provides the API for media key client implementations.

classes.name: IMediaKeysClient
classes.description: An interface for media key event notifications, to be implemented by classes that handle license requests, renewals, and key status changes.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Notifies that a license request needs to be sent, providing the session ID, license request message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Notifies that a license renewal is required, providing the session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Notifies that the status of keys in a session has changed, providing the session ID and key status vector.
